overview_description.description:
SpeakUp is an AI-powered speaker search platform that connects event organizers, journalists, podcasters, and companies with expert speakers. The app simplifies and accelerates the process of finding, booking, and managing speakers for events, conferences, and media appearances.

One-Click Speaker App – Organizers post an event, and speakers respond instantly.
Free Matching System – AI-powered recommendations based on expertise, ratings, and event requirements.
Ratings & Reviews – Quality control via speaker and event feedback.
In-App Chat – Seamless communication between organizers and speakers.
Speaker Club & Awards – Private club for top speakers with exclusive benefits.
